Battery saver
Pauses animated backgrounds, the visualizer, the neon cursor and the glow. “Auto” turns it on when the battery is below 20% and not charging.
Privacy
Everything stays on this device. Voxelify sends nothing to anyone.“Don't track listening” keeps no listening history or statistics. “Don't track anything” also forgets recent searches.

Upload a track

Upload the track to Audius or the Internet Archive (both free) and paste its link here. A direct https link to an mp3 works too. Voxelify keeps the link, the title and the cover; people will find the track in the search and on your profile.
